descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B31 · P2 · 新

按状态排序时同一个状态被拆成两段：没存状态的病人显示「Not Yet Prepped」，却排进了「Pre-Rounded」那一段

票：TFA-92581 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev

思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S08 「状态排序 × 每种状态，两个模式：同一个标签排在一起，平局按房间顺序」 Status sort × every status, both contexts: same label stays together, ties in room order

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Hospital: sort by room, by name and by status each puts the list in the correct order.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4；TFA-92581 AC 5）
  • U7 Nursing Home: sort by room (unit/room), by name and by status each puts the residents in the correct order.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4；TFA-92581 AC 6）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Hospital: two patients per status in a low and a high room: pending 1/21, no status 2/22, pre-rounded 3/23, seen 4/24, in-encounter 5/25, note-ready 6/26, post-rounded 7/27, complete 8/28. Nursing Home, all on Today's Visits: pending, no status, pre-rounded, in-encounter, note-ready, complete, post-rounded on units 'R …

When On the Hospital list choose the status sort and load every patient; on Nursing Home Today's Visits choose the status sort; then open All Residents with the status sort

Then Cards with the same visible status label form one contiguous block: Hospital Not Yet Prepped (pending + no status), Pre-Rounded, Seen (seen + in-encounter), Note Ready, Complete (post-rounded + complete); NH Pending (pending + no status), Pre-Rounded, In Visit, Note Ready, Complete (complete + post-rounded). Inside each block the rooms ascend

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Judged now on a Q4-independent invariant (U2, U7): labelGroupsContiguous and roomAscendingWithinLabel per checkpoint. The absolute order of the blocks is recorded for Q4, not judged. Predicted from code: Fail. A no-status record sorts with Pre-Rounded (STATUS_RANK[''] ?? 1) but shows Not Yet Prepped / Pending, so that block is split

在哪跑：dev 上的 datasets（种数据集跑列表）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S08 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：新的产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92581 ready for qa

按状态排序时，同一个状态被拆成了两段：没存状态的病人显示「Not Yet Prepped」/「Pending」，却被排进了「Pre-Rounded」那一段，所以医院列表和养老院两个列表上同一个标签都出现在两处。

Sorting by status splits one visible status into two blocks: patients with no stored status show 'Not Yet Prepped' or 'Pending' but sort among 'Pre-Rounded', so the same label appears in two places on the Hospital and both Nursing Home lists.

依据：datasets lane (status dataset): Hospital blocks are NYP×5, PR×1, NYP×1, PR×2…, with the same split on NH Today and All. The cause is the STATUS_RANK[''] ?? 1 fallback; snf:add and rounding:add store no status when the client omits it. This was predicted in the TC-03 risks and the Q4 text mentions the code fact, but it is not in the dev report, ledger or knownGaps. It fails the Q4-independent invariant. The block order itself is only recorded, for Q4.

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev，lane datasets（datasets/results.json，截图不附）。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本（PW (labelGroupsContiguous / roomAscendingWithinLabel on card order)）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev/datasets。
